AppSpace.title: AppSpace
AppSpace.description: Direct synchronized workspace for link groups, links, and settings stored in Firestore without requiring user login.

groups.description: Array of link groups containing link items.

settings.description: Application display settings like base theme and new tab preference.

/app_spaces/{spaceId}.description: Synchronized links workspace document keyed by space ID (e.g. default) to prevent data loss across code updates without requiring login.
